requirements.note: Large-title list of all 160 recipes: title, category (tinted), clock+time, star+rating, chevron; count header '160 Recipes · By Name'.
Horizontal chip row All + 9 categories; search matches title and ingredient; Desserts + 'lemon' gives 9 results; good 'No Results' state that keeps chips visible.
Sort button opens a native menu (Name A to Z / Time quickest / Rating) with a checkmark; header reflects the sort; the choice survives relaunch.
Header card with time/servings/rating tiles, system stepper scales quantities with proper fractions (2½, ¼), stepper disabled at 1, numbered step badges.
Heart in nav bar toggles; swipe-left Favorite on list rows; heart badge on favorited rows; Favorites tab with swipe-to-Remove and a helpful empty state with a Browse Recipes button.

tells: Category filter is a hand-built scrolling chip/capsule row rather than a system control (menu picker or scope bar).
At the largest text size the pinned search field plus the sticky '160 Recipes · By Rating' header take up almost half the screen and rows scroll underneath a translucent header.
A.scroll: Smooth slow drags and flings with no blank or popping rows; flinging back to the top and pulling past it rubber-bands normally, and the scroll position is kept after returning from a recipe.

requirements.note: Inset-grouped list of 160 recipes with title and a 'Category · time · ★ rating' subtitle, chevron, count header.

Category pop-up menu (All Categories + 9) works together with search across titles and ingredients (Desserts + 'lemon' gives 9). The no-results state has a Clear Search button but hides the category/sort controls.
Segmented control Name/Time/Rating sorts correctly; the choice survives relaunch.

Summary card (time, rating, category), 'Serves' row with stepper, ingredient quantities right-aligned and scaled (4⅔, ⅛ g) with a 'scaled from 6' note, numbered steps. Servings appear only in the stepper row.
Heart in nav bar toggles; Favorites tab lists saved recipes with swipe-to-Delete and a hint; helpful empty state with Browse Recipes. There's no favorite action from the main list.

bugs: A horizontal swipe on a recipe row in the main list opens the recipe, as though the drag were a tap (it happened twice).
tells: The search keyboard turns Shift back on (uppercase keys) after each typed word mid-entry, so the field seems to be reset on each keystroke.
The servings value is an editable text field that floats in the middle of the Serves row, away from the stepper.
Empty-state titles ('No Favorites Yet', 'No Recipes Found') use regular weight, not the bold title of the system ContentUnavailableView.
The no-results state removes the category and sort controls, so you can't widen the filter without clearing the search.
B.scroll: Smooth drags and flings with no blank rows or stutter; the search bar collapses under the large title as in a system list, and the position is kept (a small offset) after returning from a recipe.

why: Both meet every requirement, and B's menu picker and segmented control are very idiomatic. A goes further: swipe-to-favorite in the list, heart badges, a richer recipe header, and a no-results state that keeps the filters. B has a real gesture bug (a horizontal swipe opens the recipe) and small text-field and keyboard oddities that A doesn't have.
